title: A Heart That Chose Distance
content:
The silence on the phone lasted for several seconds.

Finally...

Siddu took a deep breath.

"Sneha..."

"Ever since you confessed your feelings to me..."

"My heart hasn't been at peace."

"I've been thinking about you constantly."

"I kept asking myself the same question again and again."

He closed his eyes.

"And I finally found my answer."

There was a brief silence.

Then he spoke in a soft voice.

"Yes..."

"I love you."

On the other end of the call...

Sneha's heart skipped a beat.

A smile slowly began to appear on her face.

But before she could say anything...

Siddu continued.

"That's exactly why..."

"I can't accept your love."

The smile on Sneha's face disappeared.

She remained completely silent.

Siddu's voice grew heavier.

"You're one of the most wonderful people I've ever met."

"Your kindness..."

"Your character..."

"Your heart..."

"Any man would be lucky to have someone like you."

"But I..."

He paused.

"I'm not the right person for you."

"My heart still carries the scars of my past."

"But I'm afraid those scars might one day hurt you too."

"I have responsibilities waiting for me."

"My career..."

"My family..."

"My future in a new country..."

"I don't know if I'll be able to give you the love, time, and attention you truly deserve."

"I don't want you to spend your life waiting for someone who may fail you."

"So..."

"As much as it hurts me to say this..."

"I can't ask you to walk this uncertain path with me."

Silence.

A long...

Painful silence.

Finally...

Sneha spoke.

"So..."

"You do love me?"

"But you're still saying no?"

Her voice trembled.

Siddu closed his eyes.

"Yes."

"I love you."

"But I don't think I'm the right choice for you."

"You have a beautiful future ahead of you."

"I want you to live it without carrying my burdens."

Sneha took a deep breath.

The pain in her heart slowly turned into disappointment.

"I understand."

"Thank you..."

"Mr. Siddu."

"At least now..."

"I have my answer."

"I wish you a safe journey."

"Goodbye."

Before Siddu could say another word...

The call disconnected.

The silent tone echoed through the room.

Siddu slowly lowered his phone.

He remained motionless.

His father quietly walked over and placed a hand on his shoulder.

"Siddu..."

"Sometimes..."

"The decisions that seem right today..."

"Become the regrets we carry tomorrow."

"So..."

"Always think twice before choosing a path that cannot be undone."

Siddu nodded slowly.

"I will, Dad."

He stepped forward and hugged his father tightly.

"Love you, Dad."

His father gently patted his back.

"I love you too, son."

Tears quietly rolled down Siddu's cheeks.

He didn't know whether he had just protected Sneha...

Or broken both of their hearts.

A few hours later...

He reached the airport.

As the airplane slowly began moving toward the runway...

He looked out of the window.

His childhood...

His parents...

His friends...

Every beautiful memory he had ever lived in India replayed before his eyes.

And among them...

One face appeared again and again.

Sneha.

The girl who had loved him without expecting anything in return.

As the aircraft rose above the clouds...

Siddu quietly closed his eyes.

Leaving India behind...

Was never the hardest part.

Leaving Sneha behind...

Was.
